lastChange.note: Round 4, later: new card WaitGroup, home grouped by what waits on the owner: a summary sentence; a group per project with something waiting (its row with its phase gauge, one line and a slim two-week strip of the events that matter, then its waiting rows, each saying what it holds up, the longest wait first and marked); the quiet projects folded into one row. DeskMap leaves home and is kept for the record. decisions/questions/P-005-design-round-4.md, answers 9 to 12.
